title: Using Heaven and Earth as a Chessboard
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji completed his formation, an eye slowly opened in the depths of the Void—Cosmic Eye officially gazed upon.

text.content: Ling Yuan's eyes turned pure silver white, reflecting not the mortal world but the vast starry sky. The Heavenly Dao Eye's pressure crushed down like physical force, and all the structures in the great hall groaned simultaneously under the strain. Su Qingyao's face turned deathly pale, but Chen Ji pulled her behind him. She felt the temperature of that invisible hand—not killing intent, but protection.

dialogue.content: Mortal ant, you dare to touch what should not belong to you.

text.content: The voice did not come from Ling Yuan's mouth, but rang directly in everyone's Mental Sea, as if the Heavenly Dao itself was speaking. Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Nian simultaneously clutched their heads, expressions filled with pain—their Heavenly Fate Values were being forcibly extracted by that pressure.

dialogue.content: I'd like to ask the Heavenly Dao Eye—in these ten thousand years, how many 'mortal ants' have you devoured to compile this present facade?

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. He slowly raised his right hand, and the Tianji Sword coalesced in his palm. The Tianji Record inscriptions flowed endlessly across the blade, facing that silver-white eye in the sky from afar. The two wills collided in the Void, and the great hall's roof could no longer withstand the strain, exploding with a thunderous roar.

dialogue.content: You think that by relying on a fragmentary Tianji Record, you can play chess against the Heavenly Dao? How ridiculous. You are merely a piece in a much larger chess game.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled—that smile was so gentle it sent chills down one's spine. He raised his hand, and the Tianji Sword transformed into flowing light and stabbed into his own chest—not self-destruction, but using blood as ink and life as paper. Su Qingyao let out a cry of alarm, yet she saw brilliant golden light bloom from Chen Ji's chest as a fate chessboard stretching across the heavens slowly unfurled.

On the chessboard, mountains and rivers, cities and sects, and countless living creatures all manifested. And the Heavenly Dao Eye's silver-white pressure, the instant it touched the edge of the chessboard, was forcibly rebounded. For the first time, the Heavenly Dao Eye showed a fluctuation—it was astonishment.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji uses Heaven and Earth as a chessboard to declare war on the Heavenly Dao Eye. At this moment he needs to reveal his trump card. What do you hope he reveals first?

choices.description: Let allies appear, displaying the complete military layout, proving this is not personal heroism but a carefully planned hunt
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy has hidden moves, allies will be exposed to danger

dialogue.content: Since the Heavenly Dao wants to see the chess game—then let it see enough.

text.content: As Chen Ji's words fell, three rays of light simultaneously lit up on the fate chessboard. To the north, Han Lie's beast tide army had fully assembled; to the south, at the Xuanwu Sect Holy Sect, Ye Qing's demonic mist was quietly spreading; to the east, at the Tianqing Sect, Su Qingyao's Inner Disciples stood ready. Three armies, three directions, advancing toward the Heavenly Dao Eye simultaneously.

choices.description: Let Chen Nian step forward, proving that the Heavenly Fate Lock Key's power can disrupt the Heavenly Dao Eye's foresight, fundamentally weakening the enemy
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian will bear the greatest pressure
choices.visible_reward: Cut off the Heavenly Dao Eye's greatest advantage
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao Eye may preemptively attack Chen Nian

text.content: Chen Nian walked out slowly, her presence like a massive magnet, firmly attracting all the Heavenly Dao Eye's attention. However, in the instant that silver-white eye focused, all images of Chen Nian on the fate chessboard became blurred—the Heavenly Dao Eye could not 'see clearly' for the first time.

choices.description: Release Mo Xiansheng's final page of sealing, displaying the ultimate truth of the Tianji Record to completely震慑 the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the ultimate knowledge to oppose the Heavenly Dao Eye

dialogue.content: Very well, since my master has made the decision, this old one shall accompany him one final time.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment burned away on Chen Ji's chest, transforming into a golden pillar of light piercing through heaven and earth. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested one last time, his gaze toward Chen Ji filled with deep satisfaction: 'Remember, the Tianji Record is merely a key. The real chess game exists in your heart.' With these words, he scattered into countless light motes, and the final page of knowledge flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea—the ultimate secret of how to 'reshape the Heavenly Dao.'

The Heavenly Dao Eye's silver-white pupil contracted violently. It saw that the three armies on the chessboard had completed their encirclement, saw Chen Nian's blurred figure disrupting its foresight, and saw the terrifying possibility contained within that final page of knowledge. For the first time, it felt—threatened.

dialogue.content: You're mad! If you reshape the Heavenly Dao, you will be counterattacked by the Heavenly Dao itself!
Did I, Chen Ji, spend ten thousand years laying plans only to fear such a price? As for the Heavenly Dao Eye—through ten thousand years of chess games, did you ever imagine you would become a piece?

text.content: Chen Ji's figure rose infinitely tall on the fate chessboard. At this moment, he was no longer an unnamed servant, but the Chess Player commanding the world's chessboard. His voice spread across the three realms: 'All, today I, Chen Ji, hereby declare—I choose the third path: break the chess game, reshape the Heavenly Dao! Those who follow me, let us face life and death together!'

dialogue.content: Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao of the Tianqing Sect, willing to follow Brother Chen through fire and water!
Holy Sect Demon Empress Ye Qing, tired of being used as a chess piece by the Holy Sect. From today, I bet on Chen Ji's victory!
Brother, Nian has waited for this day too long. Whether living or dying, we must be together.

This old one, Ling Yuan... having executed the Heavenly Dao's will for ten thousand years, only today do I understand what a true Chess Player is. I am willing to use this decrepit body to open the way for Young Friend Chen!'

text.content: The voices of the four core allies merged into a torrent, resonating with Chen Ji's will. On the fate chessboard, their life trajectories began to intertwine, forming an unbreakable net of destiny. The three armies advanced simultaneously, pressing toward the central point where the Heavenly Dao Eye resided.

The Heavenly Dao Eye let out a furious roar, its silver-white pressure transforming into countless Heavenly Dao chains, attempting to tear apart that net of destiny. However, each time it locked onto a target, that target became blurred—like Chen Nian. The power of the Tianji Record was protecting all allies, letting the Heavenly Dao Eye experience for the first time the despair of 'having no下手.'

dialogue.content: Do you see? These are the 'mortal ants' you spoke of. We seek no immortality, fear no destruction—we only wish to personally write our own destiny.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, and the Tianji Sword coalesced once more. This time, what flowed across the blade was no longer the inscriptions of the Tianji Record, but the life trajectories of the four allies—Su Qingyao's sharpness, Ye Qing's scheming, Chen Nian's purity, and Ling Yuan's vicissitudes. Four forces gathered at the sword's tip, pointing directly at the Heavenly Dao Eye's core.

In the instant before the Tianji Sword was about to strike, in the depths of the Void, a massive eye slowly opened. That eye was deeper and more ancient than the Heavenly Dao Eye, reflecting not the starry cosmos but countless 'Chess Players' like Chen Ji—without exception, all had failed, turning to dust. The main body of the Heavenly Dao Eye had finally appeared.

Chen Ji felt that eye's gaze, yet he did not retreat. The corner of his mouth curved into a smile—that smile contained madness, resolve, and a confidence that transcended all previous 'Chess Players.' 'Cosmic Eye?'
